packages.summary: Rigid mesh clusters, static scenery HLOD, CPU occlusion and offline baked surface proxies
packages.notes: Use geometry_catalog/analyze before setting explicit policies. Ordinary instancing remains for crowds. HLOD is static scenery only, not gameplay or fog visibility. Verify real cameras and hardware; no virtual geometry streaming or GPU Hi-Z.

packages.summary: Fixed arithmetic, vectors and trigonometry
packages.notes: Use existing Fixed; angles in turns. Check zero vectors and overflow.

packages.summary: FIFO queue and stable top-K
packages.notes: Store queue under NativeState. top ties preserve input order; sort entity inputs by index.

packages.summary: BFS and topological ordering
packages.notes: Use dense IDs. Test unreachable nodes, cycles and duplicate edges. Weighted search and flows remain planned.

packages.summary: Existing game spatial queries
packages.notes: Read current game query API; batch queries. Never infer visibility from presentation. New spatial index adapter remains planned.

packages.summary: Four-neighbor multi-source distance fields
packages.notes: Use row-major IDs. Zero cells are blocked. Bound work and cache under NativeState. Test borders and unreachable cells.

packages.summary: Existing pathfinding and flow fields
packages.notes: Reuse movement commands; do not move entities from view scripts. Test blocked goals, arrival and planets separately.

packages.summary: FSM transitions and utility selection
packages.notes: Persist current state explicitly. Definitions are immutable. Utility ties choose smaller ID. BT/GOAP remain planned.

packages.summary: Priority task claiming and worker release
packages.notes: Use unique task IDs and numeric priority. Set status pending initially. Release dead workers; validate ownership before finishing. Dependencies remain planned.

packages.summary: Atomic integer recipe consumption
packages.notes: Use resource indices and nonnegative integer amounts. Duplicate ingredients are summed. This operates on caller stock, not engine resources; never create a competing economy.

packages.summary: Ordered all/any predicates
packages.notes: Keep functions in immutable definitions, never persistent NativeState. Empty all is true; empty any false. Formula parser remains planned.

packages.summary: Weighted selection and level thresholds
packages.notes: Supply simulation RNG as draw(total), integer 1..total. Zero total returns nullopt. Test zero weights and endpoints. Pity systems remain planned.

packages.summary: Event counters and one-shot completion
packages.notes: Use unique goal IDs and positive integer targets. Save progress. Emit completion only on threshold crossing. Branching dialogue remains planned.

packages.summary: Existing deterministic map generator
packages.notes: Reuse generation presets and engine seeds. Validate fair starts and connectivity. New Poisson/WFC adapters remain planned.

packages.summary: Smoothstep, lerp and timeline progress
packages.notes: Use presentation C++ only. Zero duration completes at start. Read sim events and never write simulation NativeState.

packages.summary: Existing UI templates
packages.notes: Reuse RmlUi templates and localization. Send commands through documented bindings. Virtualized list package remains planned.

packages.summary: Existing snapshot restoration verification
packages.notes: Run tests and sample matches for sim changes. Restore verification does not prove cross-platform determinism. Profile separately from verification.

packages.summary: Context and priority input routing, axis deadzones, selection, control groups and drag gestures
packages.notes: Use normalized platform input. Resolve UI/modal context before game context; send resulting gameplay actions as commands. Store selection/control groups in local presentation state.

packages.summary: RTS/follow/orbit target controls, limits, smoothing and strategic icon threshold
packages.notes: Use delta time only in presentation. Apply resulting Pose to the existing client/editor camera. World-to-sphere mapping remains the planet camera responsibility.

packages.summary: Placement checks, resource explanations, refunds and native construction commands
packages.notes: Call checkPlacement with authoritative map/territory/slope queries. Render its Decision as preview, then submit buildCommand. The engine must revalidate the command at execution time; previews never reserve or debit resources.

packages.summary: Target/range/resource checks and optional native cast/cooldown lifecycle
packages.notes: For built-in abilities send abilityCommand and use engine cooldown/effects. Use AbilityState only for custom native mechanics, and persist all fields. Charge custom resource costs transactionally only after validation.

packages.summary: Stacked inventory, weight/slot limits, atomic transfer, equipment and crafting
packages.notes: Prefer built-in engine item mechanics for existing item types. For custom native inventories validate item definitions, provide stable IDs, serialize each stack/equipment field, and require ownership checks in commands.

packages.summary: Leader election, role ordering, formation slots and native group commands
packages.notes: Use formationCommand for engine formations; use formationSlots for custom planning only. Sort/tie-break by entity ID. Feed desired slots to navigation rather than teleporting units.

packages.summary: Event-to-sound/particle/animation/notification/camera actions with cooldowns
packages.notes: Bind dispatch callbacks to existing presentation services. Use only accepted sim events; clear FeedbackState after rollback/seek and never feed it into gameplay logic.

packages.summary: Event-driven tutorial stages, counters, branches, skip and hard/soft action gating
packages.notes: Validate immutable steps at load. Persist step/progress/complete in NativeState. Hard gating must also validate commands, not only hide UI. Highlight is a host UI target ID, not a renderer.

packages.summary: Transactional versioned state migrations plus checksummed JSON backup tools
packages.notes: Migrate on import/load before installing state. Engine nativeModules VERSION compatibility is distinct: this API cannot force an incompatible engine save to load. Use gameplay.py save/restore for JSON envelopes only.

packages.summary: Structured refusal codes, values and bounded decision traces
packages.notes: Use reasonKey with Localization::tr; pass subject/required/available as parameters. Traces are diagnostic outputs only; never depend on trace capacity for simulation outcomes.

packages.summary: Content budgets, PNG dimensions, localization consistency and existing conversion tool orchestration
packages.notes: Run audit, then pipeline with explicit modelconv/audiopack paths. Conversion capability depends on the engine tool build. Source licensing is still the project author responsibility.

packages.summary: Headless seed checks, snapshot/serialized restore gates and machine-readable reports
packages.notes: Run verify against the built project-specific headless executable. Set requireWinner for combat scenarios; tutorial/sandbox scenarios may intentionally have no winner. A successful headless run does not validate UI rendering.

packages.summary: Plan and validated application of resource/building/ability/faction changes
packages.notes: Generate a plan, inspect checks, then apply with the real project-specific headless executable. Apply validates a staged copy before replacing rules.json and retains a content-addressed backup. Never overwrite a stale plan.

packages.summary: Generated C++ settings, JSON Schema, defaults and strict config parsing
packages.notes: Edit libraries/spec/gameplay.json and regenerate. C++ loader and CLI reject unknown fields, wrong types and cross-field violations. Do not edit generated files by hand.

packages.summary: Snapshot UI bindings, escaped values and bounded action queues
packages.notes: Use BindingModel.set/drain on a read-only snapshot. Invalidate after document reload or language change. Dispatch Actions through host Command routing. Do not retain simulation references.

packages.summary: Configurable screen rows, modal routing and RmlUi binding
packages.notes: Use Screen/ScreenStack and the RmlScreenBinding adapter. Supply rows for HUD, building, units, inventory, technology, pause and results. Destroy bindings before document roots. Revalidate action ownership and affordability in the sim. Rendering needs host integration and screenshot QA.

packages.summary: Safe-area layouts, density clamp and validated theme tokens
packages.notes: Use layout with framebuffer or dp units consistently; never mix them. Apply safe insets from the platform. themeStyles emits RmlUi RCSS dp units. Resolve translations before markup. Test portrait/landscape and large text.

packages.summary: Authoritative match result to idempotent meta transaction
packages.notes: Use grantMatch with aiverse::meta::Economy after authoritative completion. Link aiverse::meta and provide durable Commit CAS. Keep a stable unique match id across retries. Never call from predicted finishes, replay seeks or sim ticks. Nullopt is invalid envelope; inspect meta Result for conflict/denial.

packages.summary: Application state transitions and stale loading completion rejection
packages.notes: Use Lifecycle.send for explicit events. Capture generation before async load and call loaded(ticket). Host owns cancellation and resource cleanup. Pausing local UI must not stop a shared multiplayer simulation.

packages.summary: Transport-independent lobby, reconnect and ordered delivery policy
packages.notes: Provide transport/authentication outside this package. Use epoch on each async callback; retain sequence across reconnect and reset on a new session. Content hashes must come from verified manifests. accept is for ordered message streams, not out-of-order UDP or multiple peer channels. Do not present this as a server or netcode implementation.

packages.summary: Versioned dependency resolution, conflicts and deterministic mod order
packages.notes: Build ContentPackage records from trusted manifests, then resolveContent. Digest is required metadata, not computed or verified here; verify actual bytes through catalog pins/content tooling before mounting. Mount in returned order with explicit override rules. Never execute untrusted scripts or use manifest paths without validation.

packages.summary: Mirrored round-robin cases and aggregate faction outcomes
packages.notes: Use roundRobin with identical seed lists and swapped starts. Record actual player-to-faction mapping. Use addSample only for completed matches/draws; keep time limits separate. Run playlab.py against prepared project variations; report sample counts and seeds, not unsupported confidence claims.

packages.summary: Tick-indexed actions and assertions for automated play
packages.notes: Validate Scenario once before running. Advance at every exact tick; emit normal Commands via callback and supply authoritative metric snapshots. Missing metrics and skipped ticks fail. Reset the runner for each run; do not reuse it after rollback without restoring cursor state.

packages.summary: Nearest-rank p95, peak limits and baseline regression checks
packages.notes: Collect timing outside sim after warm-up on the same hardware/build/quality. Samples and budgets must share units. Use summarize and checkBudget; insufficient samples fail. Never let timing metrics affect deterministic gameplay. Report peak and sample count as well as p95.

packages.summary: Reusable capability and acceptance recipes for four genres
packages.notes: Use genreKit to select existing library packages and acceptance scenarios. Configure engine rules and templates before adding code. Kits are composition recipes, not complete generated games. Implement the named acceptance scenarios for the actual project and verify them.

packages.summary: Dependency-ordered change recipes and verification checklist
packages.notes: Describe explicit ChangeRecipe dependencies/files/checks and call planChanges. Unknown IDs and cycles fail. Review actual file diffs; the planner does not infer semantics or edit files. Apply supported rule mutations with existing gameplay.py recipe/apply and its stale-base checks.

packages.summary: Generate a registered external native C++ module
packages.notes: Generate into a new directory from a reviewed schema. Never overwrite custom module handlers; review the generated diff. Merge rules.fragment.json into nativeModules explicitly. Run the generated Smoke.cpp and external-native tests. Module.cpp intentionally has no game-specific effects.

packages.summary: Generate typed NativeState access and transactional migrations
packages.notes: Declare bounded int64 and bool fields. Use initialize only for empty setup state; load validates schema/ranges, store validates atomically. Define explicit rename/set/erase migration steps. Migration does not bypass engine nativeModules VERSION compatibility. Keep engine simulation state in NativeState.

packages.summary: Generate typed native Command encoders and dispatch
packages.notes: Reserve a project-unique commandType in 32768..65535 and unique action IDs. Use encode then Simulation.submit. decode checks type, action, nonneutral player, exact argument count and bounds. Handlers must separately validate player range, ownership, resources and target lifetimes. Commands do not grant authority.

packages.summary: Validate ID, file and localization/content references
packages.notes: Supply explicit source/target selectors. Use /@keys for dictionaries and /* for arrays/objects. Configure required matches for mandatory categories; optional zero matches are allowed. Use the shipped rules preset, then add schema-specific ability/audio/localization selectors. Run the real engine validator too; this is not a full rules parser.

packages.summary: Stage and atomically activate validated host settings
packages.notes: Stage with parser returning optional settings and a validator. Commit only at a safe point using expected revision. Failed staging clears pending data and preserves live settings. Handle parser exceptions in the host. Never hot-reload deterministic gameplay state using a filesystem clock; replicate gameplay changes through Commands.

packages.summary: Fixed-capacity scratch buffers and generational slot pools
packages.notes: Choose capacity from a documented budget; handle full buffers/pools explicitly. Stale or released handles fail. Slot indices are allocated in deterministic order. Capacity bounds objects, not heap memory inside T. Use fixed-size element types in hot paths. Persist pool/handle state through NativeState if it affects outcomes.

packages.summary: Deterministic round-robin work with operation budgets
packages.notes: Keep WorkItems sorted by unique ID. Each callback performs one bounded operation without modifying the items span or cursor. Persist completed counters and WorkCursor for rollback. Failed callback must leave its own output untouched. Never budget by elapsed wall time or use unordered iteration.

packages.summary: Locate the first differing native field and trace tick
packages.notes: Use firstStateDifference for NativeState-compatible maps and arrays. Export canonical tick/modules snapshots from both runs, then use project_checks.py desync. Missing or differently sampled ticks are coverage errors. Only exported fields can be diagnosed; this does not automatically instrument every ECS pool.

packages.summary: Read-only package upgrade plan from lock hashes
packages.notes: Compare schema-2 libraries.lock.json with the current catalog/engine root. Review version changes, changed transitive files and required checks. The tool never updates pins or migrates code automatically. Run project tests and update pins only as an explicit reviewed project change.

packages.summary: End-to-end real RTS simulation, RmlUi, save and meta reward example
packages.notes: Create isolated content with showcase_project.py. Build the opt-in aiverse_library_showcase target and run --auto with a fresh output directory. Check actual build/attack events, save checksum round trip, idempotent meta rewards and screenshot. Reward storage is a single-process example, not a production backend. Use distinct match IDs for distinct authoritative matches.

packages.summary: Authoritative effective stat snapshots through existing modifiers
packages.notes: Call effectiveStats after checking the entity. Configure existing StatMod/tech/level/status rules; never evaluate a parallel modifier stack. The snapshot returns final values, not an invented per-source breakdown. Missing units and invalid stats fail.

packages.summary: Status snapshots and validated entry to the existing status engine
packages.notes: Use statuses for copies of active stacks/expiry/source data. applyStatus is a simulation-only hook after authority checks, outside ECS iteration. True means valid invocation, not proof a status bypassed immunity. Engine statuses own refresh, stacks, periods, flags and hashing.

packages.summary: All/any/none tag filters and bounded-value conditions
packages.notes: Resolve type tags using Rules.tagMask; reject unknown names with resolveTags. Keep type tags separate from status/dispel tags. Missing condition inputs fail closed. Built-in EffectDef target filters remain authoritative.

packages.summary: Stable action previews plus native built-in interaction commands
packages.notes: Use interactions for sorted preview options and disabled reasons. Build actual Smart/PickItem/UseItem/Load/ToggleLock Commands with EngineMechanics.interactionCommand, then submit through Simulation. For ToggleLock actor is the selected gate; PickItem uses point. Custom actions use generated native commands and revalidate at execution. Physical carry/throw/push/ropes/doors/platforms/breakables are the separate physical-interactions package; previews here must not authorize those mutations.

packages.summary: Transactional reservation, release and consumption of custom capacities
packages.notes: Use ticket and owner IDs > 0. Repeating an identical live reservation is Duplicate; conflicting payload/owner fails. Commit validates aggregate capacity before changing stock; release does not consume. Keep built-in Inventory.reserved under its existing owner. Persist tickets with Persistence.h; handle cancellation and owner destruction.

packages.summary: Tick-based multi-stage actions with timeout and cancellation cleanup
packages.notes: Advance once per increasing tick. begin false must have no side effects; poll is read-only; cleanup is called once for each entered stage on completion/cancel/failure. One stage transition per call bounds work. Implement navigation through existing commands; persist sequence state. Couple reservations to stage cleanup.

packages.summary: Weighted loot with exclusions and a guaranteed rare threshold
packages.notes: Reuse weighted selection through rollLoot. Draw must return an integer in [1,total]; use rollSimLoot to consume sim.rng with a validated uint32 total. Guarantee N forces eligible rare loot on attempt N after N-1 misses. Impossible guarantees fail without drawing. Persist pity state and validate/exclude before sampling; reward granting remains separate.

packages.summary: Nonnegative integer step/linear progression tables and CLI preview
packages.notes: Author strictly increasing nonnegative x and nonnegative y. Endpoints clamp; linear rounding is toward the left value, including descending segments. Unsafe intermediate products return failure. Use aiverse_app_tools curve to preview exact runtime results; use engine/meta progression owners for built-in experience/rewards.

packages.summary: Bounded observation memory, expiration and threat selection
packages.notes: Feed only visibility-authorized observations; never enumerate hidden enemies into memory. Keep known positions after lost sight until tick TTL expires. Highest threat ties by smaller entity ID; capacity evicts oldest, then smaller ID, and rejects older incoming observations. Use stable packed IDs and clear destroyed targets only when knowledge permits. Persist via Persistence.h.

packages.summary: Bounded structured decision facts using existing reason codes
packages.notes: Collect facts from the actual authoritative calculation, including localization key/subject/required/actual/reason. explain keeps the first failure even when fact output is truncated. Do not infer damage/modifier explanations from guessed formulas. Send display-only reports to UI/debug consumers; keep diagnostics out of state hashes unless they drive behavior.

packages.summary: RTS bot profiles and transactional checkpoints over the existing RtsAI
packages.notes: Use existing RtsAI for economy, build/research, combat, garrisons and terrain/planet play. Host calls update before sim.step. rules.ai may override profiles. Preserve the legacy knowledge policy; do not claim fog-fairness. Save bot state with simulation; exact player/seed/settings must match.

packages.summary: Command-driven FPS bots with perception, reaction, aiming, reload, retreat, zone and patrol
packages.notes: Run on one authoritative host with map bot:false for owned slots. Use fpsCommand then sim.submit; never mutate actors. Persist FpsState with the simulation. Supply generated navmesh or authored waypoint graph; no bomb, loot or vehicle mechanics are implied.

packages.summary: Automatic deterministic layered AABB navigation mesh with clearance, erosion and bounded routing
packages.notes: Build immutable regional polygon meshes from current collision and motor dimensions. Rebuild on geometry changes. Bound cell/polygon/candidate/search budgets. No triangle/slope importer or cross-region streaming links. Use navPath/navStep, real motor tests and aiverse_navmesh exporter.

packages.summary: Actual RTS/FPS bot matches, decision counters and restoration regression tests
packages.notes: Build aiverse_bot_match and root library bot/navmesh tests. Example FPS navmesh bounds target arena; author region bounds for other maps. A timeout is not a win, and bot difficulty presets are not an Elo claim.

packages.summary: Fixed character movement policy: ground/air acceleration, jump buffer, coyote time, slopes, ledges, ladders, swimming, climbing and mantle/vault modes
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md for exact coverage and authority boundaries. 0.2.0 adds LocomotionModes.h: a Ground/Air/Ledge/Ladder/Swim/Climb/Mantle state machine driven by owner-reported environment queries (no physics inside), optional locomotion.* settings, versioned/hashable LocomotionState; stepMotion is unchanged. Policies do not automatically replace existing engine movement/combat/victory or wire presentation. Persist versioned state and bind immutable definitions. Use actual native/host owners for commands, collision and damage.

packages.summary: Custom melee timing, buffered combos, active-window hit deduplication and defense outcomes
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md for exact coverage and authority boundaries. Policies do not automatically replace existing engine movement/combat/victory or wire presentation. Persist versioned state and bind immutable definitions. Use actual native/host owners for commands, collision and damage.

packages.summary: Frame-keyed hitboxes/hurtboxes (sphere/capsule/box), dodge invulnerability, directional guard and perfect parry, poise/stagger and lock-on targeting composed over melee-combat
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (combat-actions) for exact coverage and authority boundaries. Produces contacts and outcomes only: damage, stamina, health and statuses stay with the existing combat owner. Fixed math and integer ticks; repeated/backwards ticks are rejected. Persist CombatActorState via genre::save/load (record kinds 32..36) and hash it with combatHash.

packages.summary: Per-agent stealth perception: sight cones with near/peripheral ranges and owner multipliers, hearing with occlusion and noise budgets, footprint/scent trails, suspicion meters with Unaware/Suspicious/Searching/Alert thresholds, delayed ally alerts with shared last known positions, deterministic search points, disguises and hiding spots
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (stealth-senses) for exact coverage and authority boundaries. Generic per-agent policy, not RTS fog of war (modules/rts vision stays authoritative there). The owner supplies poses, light/cover/stance/visibility multipliers, LOS and occlusion callbacks (called in observer-id then target/noise order under per-tick budgets) and search candidates; outputs are PerceivedTarget records and SenseEvents, never movement. Fixed math, integer ticks, repeated/backwards ticks rejected. Persist SensesState via genre::save/load (record kinds 48..55 reserved, 48..52 used) and hash with sensesHash; bind sensesConfigHash. Optional `senses` settings section.

packages.summary: Authoritative scene flow: integer-ratio time-scale domains (world/player/ui/cinematic) with stacked priority requests, exact accumulators, hit-stop/slow-motion presets; scene timelines of dialogue/animation/camera/sound/event cues with play/pause/skip/seek; sync waits on host-reported line/marker/in-position facts with timeouts; QTE press/mash/hold/sequence judged on input ticks with difficulty and accessibility; interaction staging with marks, teleport fallback and input locks; checkpoint requests and resume at sync points; narrative cue triggers
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (cinematic-gameplay) for the determinism model. Authoritative: time-scale requests/accumulators, timeline position, cue emission (essential cues once per run, presentation cues once per pass), wait/QTE outcomes, staging and input locks. Host: audio/animation/camera playback and navigation, reported back as tick-stamped SceneInput; every wait and staging move has a timeout so devices cannot stall the sim. stepTime/stepScene once per strictly increasing tick; invalid input returns nullopt with state untouched. Narrative CueRequest{cueId} bridges through cueTrigger/sceneForCue. Persist TimeState/SceneState via genre::save/load (record kinds 72..79 reserved, 72..75 used); hash with cinematicHash and bind sceneLibraryHash. Optional `cinematic` settings section. No rendering, audio, animation playback or cutscene editor. genre/NarrativeCinematicBridge.h (queueNarrativeCues/releaseNarrativeCues) schedules narrative-graphs CueRequest records (tick + delayTicks, deduped by sequence) into TriggerCue scene commands; its NarrativeCueQueue is record kind 76.

packages.summary: Card and board game rules: data-defined cards (units/spells/instants with targets and ordered effects: damage, heal, draw, energy, buff, counter, reveal, mill) and rule variants (hand/health/energy curve, draw per turn, first-player skip, fatigue, overdraw burn, board limit, turn limit, separate combat phase, rush, partial/full mulligan); seeded deck shuffles, draw/mulligan, phases, legal action generation, LIFO effect stack with priority passing, counters and fizzling on invalid targets, guard attacks, per-seat hidden information with a non-leaking cardViewFor projection and redacted/reveal events
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (Cards and turn strategy) for exact coverage. Composes card-runtime's zone vocabulary (cardRuntimeZone) and leaves strategy/Cards.h unchanged. cardGameSetup/stepCardGame are the only mutation path: strictly increasing command seq, seat holding priority, action in cardLegalActions (computed from the seat's own view); invalid input returns nullopt with state and RNG untouched; RNG (passed-in aiverse::Random) only for setup/mulligan shuffles. Send seats only cardViewFor/cardEventsFor; lockstep replication is not confidential. Persist CardGameState via genre::save/load (record kind 96; 96..103 reserved for cards+turns), hash with cardGameHash, bind cardLibraryHash. JSON via readCardLibrary/readCardDecks with path-qualified errors; optional cardGame settings section. No deck builder, trigger/replacement language, collection or transport.

packages.summary: Turn strategy on square/hex grids: weighted 8-way/hex movement with deterministic reachable sets and paths, half/full cover from the owner grid with a flank angle, integer line of fire and shot previews (hit chance milli), action points, per-round initiative with speed modifiers and stable-id ties, delay, overwatch reservations firing reaction shots, per-team visibility projection, and WeGo simultaneous resolution (collected orders, lockstep movement with contested-cell/swap rules, simultaneous fire)
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (Cards and turn strategy) for exact coverage. turn-scheduler (strategy/Turns.h, fixed order + nested LIFO reactions) is unchanged and remains the choice for host-applied effects; tactics-grid owns a dynamic order. stepTactics / tacticsResolveWeGo: strictly increasing seq, active unit only, action in tacticsLegalActions; invalid input returns nullopt with state untouched; one RNG draw per shot from the passed-in aiverse::Random. Send teams only tacticsViewFor/tacticsEventsFor. Persist TacticsState (98) and TacticsOrders (99) via genre::save/load; hash with tacticsHash, bind tacticsScenarioHash. JSON via readTacticsScenario with path-qualified errors; optional tactics settings section. Units never block line of fire; no elevation, destructible cover, campaign or animation.

packages.summary: Deterministic turn and card bots that see only their own view: a tactics turn planner scoring reachable destinations, attacks and overwatch (expected damage, kill chance, seen threats, cover, objective advance) under a bounded search budget, and a card evaluator scoring legal actions with real-rules simulation on a view-rebuilt state and bounded lookahead
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (Cards and turn strategy). Bots return player-equivalent CardAction/TacticsAction for stepCardGame/stepTactics and never write state; inputs are cardViewFor/tacticsViewFor only (hidden cards and unseen units cannot change a choice, tested). No RNG; stateless (nothing to persist). Budgets: cardGame.botNodeBudget/botDepth and tactics.botSearchBudget settings.

packages.summary: Seeded spread, recoil, swept projectiles with ricochets, material penetration, radial explosions, ammo feeds/overheat, charge tiers, attachment stacking and ballistic aim/lead solving
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md for exact coverage and authority boundaries. Policies do not automatically replace existing engine movement/combat/victory or wire presentation. Persist versioned state and bind immutable definitions. Use actual native/host owners for commands, collision and damage. 0.2.0 adds genre/Ballistics.h (penetration, explosions, launch/intercept solver), genre/WeaponMods.h (ammo feeds, charge modes, attachments), genre/WeaponData.h (settings adapters and weapons JSON) and genre/WeaponPersistence.h (save/load kinds 16-18 and hashing); Weapons.h API is unchanged. Built-in FPS ammo/reload stays authoritative.

packages.summary: Deterministic genre bot policies: melee spacing/attack timing/dodge-parry/lock-on, shooter aim/lead/burst/reload/overheat/cover, squad roles with formations and an objective choice hook
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (genre-bots) for exact coverage. Bots return player-equivalent inputs (MeleeInput, ShooterInput, role orders, objective choice) for the owner's ordinary command path and never write state. Perception is owner-supplied and must be visibility-authorized. Owner RNG only; repeated/backwards ticks rejected. Persist MeleeBotState/ShooterBotState/SquadState via genre::save/load (record kinds 56-58, 59-63 reserved) and hash them with genreBotHash. bots/SensesPerception.h (perceivedFromSenses) turns stealth-senses PerceivedTarget records into bot input: visible+Alert targets are engageable with owner facts, Searching targets are remembered at lastKnown.

packages.summary: Team score events, rounds, overtime, draws and objective modes: capture/hold zones and king of the hill, payload, elimination with lives and respawn waves, extraction, bomb/defuse, ordered route gates, contested overtime clock and spectator transitions
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md for exact coverage and authority boundaries. Policies do not automatically replace existing engine movement/combat/victory or wire presentation. Persist versioned state and bind immutable definitions. Use actual native/host owners for commands, collision and damage. 0.2.0 adds genre/MatchObjectives.h (objective policies returning ObjectiveEvents, awardObjectiveEvents/awardObjectiveWin through awardScore, save/load kinds 40-47 and hashObjective), genre/MatchObjectivesConfigured.h (objectives settings adapters and cross-field errors) and genre/MatchObjectivesData.h (zones/payload path/route gates JSON); Match.h API is unchanged. Presence, deaths, pickups and gate crossings come from the authoritative owner; built-in victory modes stay with their modules.

packages.summary: Localized narrative graphs with conditional choices and atomic fact transactions; 0.2.0 social scenes: typed int/bool/enum facts with persistent world state, per-character affinity/trust/fear meters, per-character knowledge and reveals, AND/OR/NOT conditions, one-shot flags, chapter/act state, deferred consequences (N ticks or scenes later), speakers/participants, cinematic CueRequest events, prioritized ambient barks with cooldowns and visual-novel backlog/skip-read/auto-advance
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (Narrative scenes) for exact coverage and authority boundaries. Legacy Story/readStory/StoryState (record kind 7) are unchanged; readNarrativeWorld also loads the legacy story JSON. NarrativeScenes.h runs one stepNarrative per authoritative tick (strictly increasing ticks, commands deduplicated by increasing ID, invalid commands rejected atomically) and returns events, CueRequest records (NarrativeCues.h, consumed by a cinematic/UI owner; no playback here) and bark lines. Strict JSON validation with path-qualified errors (NarrativeSceneData.h). Persist NarrativeState via genre::save/load (record kinds 64..71 reserved, 64..65 used), check narrativeStateError after load and bind narrativeWorldHash/narrativeConfigHash. Optional `narrative` settings section (NarrativeConfigured.h). Text is localization keys only; rewards go through their transactional owner.

packages.summary: Initiative, AP and nested reaction scheduling
packages.notes: Bounded runtime implementation; see docs/strategy-libraries.md for limits. Audit areas T1 are only partially addressed. Persist through strategy/Persistence.h in NativeState. Do not duplicate built-in owners.

packages.summary: Card zones, priority stack and private views
packages.notes: Bounded runtime implementation; see docs/strategy-libraries.md for limits. Audit areas K1,K2 are only partially addressed. Persist through strategy/Persistence.h in NativeState. Do not duplicate built-in owners.

packages.summary: Sokoban moves, undo/redo, simple-deadlock cells and freeze deadlocks, BFS and A* solvers with node budgets, hints
packages.notes: Bounded runtime implementation; see docs/strategy-libraries.md for limits. 0.2.0 adds pushDeadCells/pushDeadlocked (sound, not complete), solvePushAStar (consistent Manhattan heuristic + deadlock pruning; BudgetExceeded is never a proof) and pushHint. Other puzzle families, move numbering and the puzzle bot are in puzzle-solvers. Persist through strategy/Persistence.h in NativeState. Do not duplicate built-in owners.

packages.summary: Deterministic puzzle rules and bounded solvers: match-3 (swap validation, line/L/T detection, special pieces from data rules, gravity + seeded refill, ordered cascades, no-move detection, shuffles that always leave a legal move, goals, hints); flood fill and region counting, color-flood game with IDA*, rotatable pipe/wire connectivity with leak checks; N-puzzle parity, always-solvable shuffles and IDA*, sliding blocks of any rectangle size (BFS), polyomino packing with rotations/flips (exact-cover backtracking, solution counting); Sokoban sessions over grid-puzzles (deadlocks, A*, undo); generic CSP over small grids (AllDifferent/Sum/Count/Runs as data: sudoku, nonogram) with propagation, bounded backtracking and uniqueness checks; puzzle bot playing through player commands
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (puzzle-solvers). Every solver takes an explicit PuzzleBudget and returns PuzzleSearch::Unknown when it runs out (never hangs, never claims a proof). Integer-only, row-major cells, fixed neighbour/candidate order; randomness only through the passed-in aiverse::Random (match-3 refill/shuffle, N-puzzle shuffle, bot mistakes). Players and bots submit the same command structs (Match3Swap, PuzzleFloodPick, PuzzlePipeRotate, PuzzleTilesSlide, PuzzleBlocksMove, PuzzlePackCommand, PuzzleCspAssign, PuzzleSokobanCommand) with strictly increasing move numbers; *Apply re-validates and leaves state untouched on rejection. JSON level data via genre/PuzzleData.h with path-qualified JsonError. Persist states via genre::save/load (record kinds 112..119 reserved, all used) and hash with puzzleHash. Puzzle bot: bots/PuzzleBot.h (difficulty = node budget + mistake chance). Executable example examples/libraries/genre/puzzles (match-3 played by the bot, Sokoban solved and replayed, sudoku uniqueness). No rendering, input mapping, level generator/editor or global (multi-level) progression.

packages.summary: Deterministic kinematic physical interactions: pick up/carry (hold point, mass limit, speed penalty, drop when blocked), charged throws with arc preview from the same integrator and swept landing, push/pull on a grid or free with friction/mass resistance and blocking, XPBD ropes/joints with a fixed iteration count, attach/detach and breaking force, hinged/sliding doors with locks, keys, one-way rules, timing and auto-reverse, waypoint moving platforms with per-rider carry deltas, breakable objects with damage types, thresholds, stages and debris requests
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (physical-interactions) for exact coverage, the determinism/network model and authority boundaries. These Fixed/integer-tick policies are the authoritative state; collision comes from the owner (WorldCollision adapts engine/world SpatialWorld). Box3D (engine/physics) is presentation-only here: it may simulate debris from DebrisRequest but is never read back. Outputs are state + InteractionEvents/requests; no rendering. Repeated/backwards ticks and invalid input return nullopt with state untouched. Platform carry deltas feed the rider position before LocomotionModes runs. Persist CarryState/PushState/RopeState/DoorState/PlatformState/BreakableState via genre::save/load (record kinds 80..87 reserved, 80..85 used), hash with interactionHash, bind interactionConfigHash and interactionDefinitionsHash. Optional `interaction` settings section. Separate from object-interactions (action preview menus and built-in engine interaction commands).

packages.summary: Deterministic kinematic vehicle controllers: wheeled arcade-sim (torque curve, auto/manual gears with shift time, per-wheel traction with slip/grip curves, weight transfer, handbrake, drift), tracked differential steering, hover altitude hold with drift damping, arcade flight with banked turns and stall; damage zones with per-zone performance penalties and critical disable; driver/passenger/gunner seats with validated enter/exit/switch/eject and owner-checked exit points; ordered checkpoints, laps, race positions, wrong-way detection and respawn at the last checkpoint; race bot (racing line, corner braking, overtaking lanes, rubber band)
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (vehicle-controllers) for the determinism/network model. The controllers are the authoritative Fixed/integer state: the owner reports ground/wheel contacts (VehicleContacts) and resolves collisions after the step with vehicleResolveCollision; no physics backend is authoritative (Box3D may only mirror poses). stepVehicle/stepVehicleDamage/stepVehicleSeats/stepRace once per strictly increasing tick; invalid input returns nullopt with state untouched. Checkpoints reuse match-rules route gates (RouteGate, crossesGate, stepRoute). bots/RaceBot.h returns a VehicleInput like a player. Persist VehicleState 88, VehicleDamageState 89, VehicleSeatState 90, RaceState 91, RaceBotState 94 via genre::save/load (88..95 shared with sports-rules); hash with vehicleHash and bind vehicleDefinitionHash/raceCourseHash/raceLineHash. Optional `vehicles` settings section. Executable example: examples/libraries/genre/vehicles-sports (4-car race). No rendering, audio, suspension geometry or tyre thermal model.

packages.summary: Deterministic ball-sport rules: possession with pickup radius and possession lock, tackles contested with the passed RNG, passes with receiver leading and shots with power and seeded accuracy error, interception at the closest approach along the ball path, goals, out of bounds and generic restarts (kickoff, throw-in, corner, goal kick, free kick, penalty, face-off), walls/rebound fields, periods with running/stopped/added-stoppage clocks and golden-goal overtime, fouls from contact rules; role-based formations with stable slot assignment; positioning bot (formation slots, press/mark/chase, keeper line, pass/shot choice)
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (sports-rules). stepSports once per strictly increasing tick with owner-reported SportsPlayer snapshots (the owner moves bodies) and SportsActions from players or bots/SportsBot.h (same struct); RNG only through the passed engine Random, untouched on invalid input. Field frame Vec2{x length, y width}, team index 0 attacks +x in odd periods (swapEnds). Persist SportsState 92 and SportsBotState 95 via genre::save/load (93 reserved; 88..95 shared with vehicle-controllers) together with the RNG state; hash with sportsHash and bind sportsDefinitionsHash. Optional `sports` settings section. Executable example: examples/libraries/genre/vehicles-sports (3v3 football). No ball height/spin, offside, referees UI or animation.

packages.summary: Colony simulation policies: colonist needs with decay, thresholds and mood bands (breaks, work speed), hour-block schedules (work/sleep/leisure), job preferences 1..4 with deterministic assignment (lib::claim, stable tie-break, stock reservations per stockpile), production recipes at workstations with bills and power requirements, haul jobs between stockpiles, construction and gathering orders, disaster alerts (fire/flood/raid) with response jobs and priority overrides/preemption, power and fluid graphs (producers/consumers/storage per connected component, deterministic brownout shedding by priority with hysteresis), and a colony planner bot that issues player-equivalent commands
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (settlement-production) for the tick order and authority split. stepColony/stepPower once per strictly increasing tick; malformed input returns nullopt with state untouched, invalid or stale commands are ignored with CommandIgnored. Players and bots::planColony (bots/ColonyPlanner.h) use the same ColonyCommand path. Composes tasks (claim), reservations (one book per stockpile, ticket = job id) and graphs (lib::Graph components); production-networks/offline-production remain the owners of instant factory links and fast-forward. Owner supplies unpowered structures (PowerReport), gather availability (renewal/ecology), mood modifiers (survivalMood) and alerts (e.g. grid-field fire). Persist ColonyState 104, PowerGridState 105 and ColonyPlannerState 110 via genre::save/load (kinds 104..111 shared with survival-ecology); hash with colonyHash/powerHash/colonyPlannerHash and bind colonyDefsHash. Optional `colony` settings section. Executable example: examples/libraries/genre/production-survival.

packages.summary: Survival and ecology policies: body model (core temperature from owner environment, clothing insulation/windproofing/waterproofing, shelter and heat sources, wetness, hunger/thirst/stamina interplay, condition and death) with weather modifiers for bodies, solar/wind power, growth and animal activity; population ecosystems per species per region (logistic growth, carrying capacity, saturating predation, starvation, migration, integer accumulators); animal behavior states wander/graze/flee/hunt/sleep from stealth-senses PerceivedTarget records; renewable resource nodes with depletion and regrowth timers
packages.notes: Read docs/genre-packages.md (survival-ecology). stepSurvival/stepEcology/stepEcologyAnimals/stepEcologyResources once per strictly increasing tick; malformed input returns nullopt with state untouched. Randomness only through the passed engine Random (ecology birth noise, wander goals). Animal decisions consume genre::PerceivedTarget (genre/Senses.h) plus owner target facts; kills/grazing/harvests are events the owner routes to populations and renewal nodes. Inventory, health owners and terrain/grid fields stay authoritative: food/drink actually consumed and shelter come from the owner. Persist SurvivalState 106, EcologyState 107, EcologyAnimalState 108, EcologyResourceState 109 via genre::save/load (kinds 104..111 shared with settlement-production); hash with survivalHash and bind survivalConfigHash/ecologyDefsHash/ecologyAnimalDefsHash. Optional `survival` settings section.
